No code changes in this release; documentation revised for clarity and conciseness.

- Rewrote and condensed documentation for better readability and operational guidance.
- Updated section titles and summaries for a direct, audience-focused presentation.
- Clarified input requirements, output modes, and compliance constraints.
- Added more explicit descriptions of operational logic (e.g., “kill gates,” “evidence chain,” “stop-loss”).
- Improved alignment with real law-firm usage scenarios and examiner-oriented drafting.

v1.1.0
- Added Limitation & Standing Control: hard-gate screening for eligibility and time-bar risks.
- Added Procedural Control Review: deadline control, suspension triggers, and admissibility checks.
- Refined Risk Engine: introduced G5 (procedural instability) and G6 (discretion dependency) stop-loss gates.
- Improved examiner readability and consistency across core/workflow/risk modules.
